kind: round-3 pre-registration before training or additive measurements
data: all 5067 validated v2e export images; project labels onto 32 new classes; retain old-only scenes with empty labels as deliberate negatives
split: train 100030-48 variants only; val 100049; no gate images used for training
initialization: separate checkpoint selecting 32 classifier rows from parked v2e; v2b file and model untouched

training.checkpoint: best.pt by Ultralytics training-validation fitness: box mAP50-95 + mask mAP50-95; not dev gate

merge.reject: strictly greater than theta overlap with any v2b mask
merge.old_output: unmodified prefix; no combined truncation or NMS that suppresses it
merge.consumer: new classes must be exact public task candidates, never category-fallback into old-only groups

gate.selection: qualify old metrics and phantom bounds first, then maximize merged hitcheck; ties choose lowest theta

selection_clarification: Before any dev measurement: original registration called best.pt a mask-only selection. Installed SegmentMetrics.fitness actually sums box and mask mAP50-95. Document the implementation rather than change the running trainer. No dev outcomes used.
